description: Everything this app knows about one ERPNext Asset that ERPNext's own Asset doctype does not hold: which cost centers use it and in what proportion, which note financed it, and which periods have already been depreciated. One profile per Asset; the Asset itself is left exactly as ERPNext made it.

fields.description: What the asset cost, copied from the Asset when the profile was created. The depreciable base is this minus the salvage value.
fields.label: Gross Purchase Amount

fields.description: What the asset is expected to be worth at the end of its useful life. Depreciation never takes the book value below it.
fields.label: Salvage Value

fields.description: Manual means this app never computes a period for this asset; the entries are written by hand.
fields.label: Depreciation Method
fields.options:
Straight Line
Written Down Value
Double Declining Balance
Manual

fields.description: Total life in months. Where the asset is financed, this is held equal to the note's tenor so paid-off and fully-depreciated fall on the same month.
fields.label: Useful Life (Months)

fields.description: How many months one depreciation period covers. 1 for monthly, 3 quarterly, 12 annually. Must divide the useful life exactly.
fields.label: Frequency (Months)

fields.description: The first day of the first depreciation period.
fields.label: Depreciation Start Date

fields.description: Debited by a depreciation run, split across the allocation rows. Taken from the Asset Category when it is not set here.
fields.label: Depreciation Expense Account

fields.description: Credited by a depreciation run, in one line.
fields.label: Accumulated Depreciation Account

fields.description: DocType of the note that financed this asset, e.g. 'Journal Entry' or a site's own Notes Payable doctype.
fields.label: Note DocType

fields.description: The note's full tenor in months, counted from the depreciation start date.
fields.label: Note Tenor (Months)

fields.description: When set, the useful life was checked against the note tenor and matched. Clearing it does not un-check anything already written.
fields.label: Tenor Enforced

fields.description: How this asset's cost is shared out. Percentages total 100; every depreciation line follows them.
fields.label: Cost Center Allocation

fields.description: Every period already written, with the Journal Entry that carries it. A period listed here is never written a second time.
fields.label: Depreciation Postings

name: Asset Cost Profile
